verdict.rationale: Steel is browser infrastructure that is not tied to any one model vendor. Its docs describe first-party integrations with Gemini Computer Use, Claude Computer Use and OpenAI Computer Use, plus agent frameworks such as Pydantic AI, which its docs call "provider-agnostic", AI SDK, CrewAI and Browser-Use. The model choice is therefore left to the developer. Missing for 10: an explicit Steel-level statement of model-agnosticism or bring-your-own-key configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of swapping providers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bring my own LLM provider — the framework is model-agnostic rather than locked to one vendor's models
